description: WhatsApp Business Platform provides APIs for businesses to programmatically send messages, make calls, and manage account assets.

evidence.claim: WhatsApp Business Platform provides APIs for businesses to programmatically send messages, make calls, and manage account assets.
Developers can self‑serve register and create a Meta app to obtain access.
A sample app and get‑started guide are provided, indicating that building an integration is possible.
Access tokens are used to authenticate API calls.
The platform offers a Cloud API for messaging, calling, and groups, and a Business Management API for managing phone numbers and templates.
